Name: Bodybuilder Alex
Author: iiswhoiis
Description:
Hi, just wanted to preface with saying that this is my first mod so any feedback would be greatly appreciated! <3

This mod aims to make some changes to Alex's character sprite to give him a bigger body.
[size=3]Changes to his body:[/size]
[list]
[*]He is slightly taller than before to fit more detail into is body. This also gives him a more gigantic, football player appearance.
[*]Added more emphasis on his upper chest, abs, and hips.
[*]Changed the width of his shoulders to be broader, making him beefier.
[*]I gave him a jockstrap while he lifts because I find this goes more with his football profile than his baggy shorts.
[*]In the original version his hair is slightly longer by accident, not too big a deal but still a change.
[*]It goes without saying that every outfit is also changed, including his flower festival outfit.
[/list]
Installation is typical for every .xnb -- Simply extract the .rar and place the file into the Characters folder of your game.
I also included an optional Hispanic version of his body to be used with the portraits of AllegedMexican's Hispanic Alex mod. I actually made this mod originally with this version's sprites and changed skin tone and hair back to normal to upload this. I am very new to this process so i'm unsure if this isn't allowed or not. This version is simply intended as a patch for their mod, so I hope that giving credit to their amazing mod is whats appropriate.

1.1 - Added a shirtless option for both the original and Hispanic Alex. The normal outfit has more detail but i'm sure some would want a shirtless option as well. I also realized that there is no shirtless option for AllegedMexican's Hispanic Alex, so without portraits the shirtless Hispanic version is kind of unnecessary. That is unless you want to make your own portraits to fit that body! I have no problem with it but other creators might, so I won't upload it here.

Anyways, I hope you enjoy the body -- if there are any problems please let me know!
